reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the sealed sachets with 2 capsules each, because I already count capsules into a pill case before every trip and this skips that. The QR batch report from a named ISO lab is more than most brands give me, so I'd try one box.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. Anyone can print 'lab-tested', so I'd want to open the QR report and see it's real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification, or a sample batch report I can open on the listing page before buying.
